progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on E in Delkash. Chaharmezrab (1:21.3) introduces G, G, centred on E. Forud (2:35.7) introduces Gb, centred on E. The line peaks at G4 (393.0 Hz) at 2:19.1. It closes on E4, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → A2 → E4 → E4).
